definitions.explanation: Being younger than someone else; a person who is younger.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{私|わたし}より{二|に}{歳|さい}{年下|としした}だ。
examples.english: She is two years younger than me.

examples.japanese: {年下|としした}の{同僚|どうりょう}に{教|おし}えてもらった。
examples.english: I was taught by a younger colleague.

examples.japanese: {夫|おっと}は{五|ご}{歳|さい}{年下|としした}です。
examples.english: My husband is five years younger than me.

notes:
FORMS:
{年|とし} (age, year) + {下|した} (below) → below in years = younger

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜より{年下|としした} - younger than ~
- {年下|としした}の{人|ひと} - younger person
- {五|ご}{歳|さい}{年下|としした} - five years younger

USAGE:
Describes age relationships between people. In Japanese society, age differences often affect how people interact and what language they use with each other.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Dating or marrying someone {年下|としした} used to be less common, especially for women with younger men, but has become more accepted in modern Japan.
